exposure: late-onset BSI (day of life 3 or later)
cohort: 4073 neonates admitted to 3 tertiary neonatal intensive care units in Pune, India, between May 2017 and April 2018.
finding: Neonatal bloodstream infections (BSIs) in this cohort were frequently caused by gram-negative bacteria with high antimicrobial resistance and were associated with significant mortality, including in term neonates.
birth_weight: Both low and non-low birth weight neonates were included.
gest_age: Both preterm and term neonates were included.
